messages:
alice: Promo stuck in change window: cd-deploy failing on cache restore (S3 504). Window 17:00 UTC. Quick call: wait for infra or pin to last-good?
ben: logs show repeated 504s during cache GET, deploybot has started exponential backoff after 4 failures.
maya: if we wait we might miss the window. Whats the risk of pin? any DB migrations?
ian: no migrations. The only risky change is a default flag flip but its behind a feature flag. Pin to last-good digest is low-risk.
alice: ok. who can approve manual promote?
ben: approvals required: ben + ian. Also ops must be notified (deploybot bypasses certain heuristics).
maya: can we do a quick rerun first (low-cost) while we prep the manual-pin PR?
ben: yes, kick rerun. I'll stand by to review PR.
ci-bot: cd-deploy rerun started (job id 76012). restoring cache from s3://redwood-cache/sha256/ff11ee...
deploybot: Promote attempt blocked: deploy throttle active (5 failures). Manual promote available with approvals.
ben: rerun hit same 504 at 45s: ```GET https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-cache/ff11ee -> 504 Gateway Timeout```
ops-bot: FYI: we are seeing elevated 5xx from our S3 proxy in us-east-1, oncall notified.
maya: timebox: if rerun fails again within 7 minutes we manual-pin.
ben: ian, i'll open the manifest PR now to pin image digest.
ian: go ahead. last-good: registry/redwood/service@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe.
ben: PR opened: github.com/redwood/deploy/PR/4821 - patch updates image to digest and adds changelog note. requesting review from ian.
\ian: reviewing now. quick lint + validate.
ci-bot: manifest-validate passed. integration smoke queued against pinned image.
deploybot: manual promote requested by ben for commit deadbeef. approvals needed: ian, alice.
ian: approved. alice: approved.
ben: merging PR and triggering manual promote. manual promote will skip auto-promotion backoff but still run canary. notifying ops channel.
\ops-bot: @support @infra manual promote in progress for release abcdef. Canary will run; watch for errors.
ci-bot: canary started. smoke tests running. cache not required for canary because image already built.
maya: pushing final release notes now, adding a Known Issue entry about transient cache 504s + mitigation steps.
\alice: good. open follow-up ticket for infra: RED-1299 to investigate S3 proxy error rate and deploybot backoff sensitivity. assign to infra.
ian: RED-1299 created. linking PR and logs.
ben: canary passed green. deploybot: promotion completed; prod updated.
alice: update changelog to call out manual-pin decision and the reason. Also add postmortem stub for RED-1299.
\meya: (typo) meant to say will add postmortem.
alice: :thumbsup: thanks team for quick coordination. closing thread.
